title: device request body claude.login
description: first request {mode} (manual = setup-token relay, automatic = mailbox automation in a login sandbox, 05-runner.md section 11.3) with, for a subscription record of ADR-090, subscription_id (the record to fill; a new ID creates it), name and note (taken for a new record, for an existing one only when given) and, for automatic, email (the address to sign in with when it is not the mailbox's own) extended (KOR-73: the client understands the new responses) and account (KOR-73: the data of a new Claude account when the address has none yet - name, birth date and the consents the owner gave explicitly; never stored); follow-up requests (header follows set): {code} (05-runner.md section 11.2), {click} (the owner's click into the picture of a human check, x and y as fractions of its width and height, KOR-73) and {relay: true} (give the automation up and continue with link and code)

name.description: the owner's label of the subscription (no control character)

note.description: the owner's remark: what the subscription is for (no line break)

account.description: data of a new Claude account (registration, KOR-73); used only when the provider asks for it, never stored

consents.description: consents the owner gave explicitly: terms (terms of use and privacy policy), age (confirmation of the minimum age), marketing (product e-mails); only these boxes are ever ticked

extended.description: the client understands the responses of KOR-73 (step verify, authorize.reason, the stages mail_code_received, registered and verified); without it the device sends none of them and a check for humans falls back to the relay at once

code.description: authorization code pasted by the user

click.description: a click of the owner into the newest picture of the human check: fractions of its width and height

relay.description: give the automation up: the device answers authorize with the link (relay)
